title: Raiders 7-round mock: How good can these guys be with Maxx Crosby on board?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Raiders 7-round mock: How good can these guys be with Maxx Crosby on board?
sources.description: With Maxx Crosby back on board and a host of free-agency additions, the 2026 Raiders have a chance to be pretty good. SB Nation’s Doug Farrar looks at one seven-round way to get the team even closer to that ideal.
